sentence: I'd like a cheese and tomato roll please
synonym: Can I have a cheese and tomato roll
synonymNote: 两者都是礼貌地点餐的表达方式，意思相同

distractors.word: I want to buy a cheese and tomato roll
distractors.note: 强调购买行为，语气不如原句礼貌自然

distractors.word: Do you have a cheese and tomato roll
distractors.note: 这是询问是否有货，而非直接点餐

distractors.word: I enjoy a cheese and tomato roll
distractors.note: 表示喜欢吃，不是在点餐或请求
